name: Ze Zeus

features.name: Super Cascades
features.description: Removes every symbol of a winning type, not just the winning cluster.

review:
Hacksaw's comic thunder god on a 6x5 cluster grid. Super Cascades remove every symbol of the winning type, not just the winning ones, so space clears fast. Win to Win means winning positions keep helping later cascades.

Three silly-named bonuses – What If Zeus Was One of Us?, Ze Zeus Take the Wheel and Ze Zeus Might Superstar – all offer the 10,000x max, as does the base game. Light-hearted look, but the cascades can run long once they get going.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
